description: Hybrid application for demolition of the Treaty Centre and associated multi-storey car park, and redevelopment for Use Class E, C3, F and Sui Generis (see consultation letter for full description). LB Hounslow ref P/2025/2650.
decision_conditions:
The London Borough of Hounslow is to be advised that this Authority (London Borough of Richmond Upon Thames) raises objection to the proposed development, on the grounds that:

•	View 26 from Richmond Park near Petersham Lodge : (Local Views SPD E 3.2). Whilst the proposed development is a significant distance away (5.5km), it is still visually intrusive. Other buildings are visible in the distance, the current proposals have a negative visual impact by breaking the skyline/ horizon line and a height well above that of other buildings in the distance; and in its red/ brown colour, in contrast to the much lighter colours of other tall buildings just under the horizon line. This would detract from the character of the landscape setting, and the view from the Registered Park & Garden.
•	View from Richmond Hill: this does not appear to be included, and should be- if the proposed development is visible in the above view, it may be visible in, and detract from, this key view, which is also a Registered Park & Garden. (Local Views SPD F1.1). This should be included for analysis, even if there should be no visibility.
